title: Luxury Living at Velvet & Vinyl - Rooftop - 6 Beds
description:
Step into Velvet & Vinyl, a beautifully curated 4-bedroom townhouse where high-end design meets an unbeatable Nashville location. Sleeping up to 12 guests across 6 beds, this home is built for groups who want space, style, and a rooftop patio that steals the show — just 3 miles from Downtown Nashville and Broadway's honky-tonks while being centrally located to all things Music City has to offer.

The space
Velvet & Vinyl lives up to its name: think rich textures, statement lighting, and a moody-glam aesthetic layered over top-of-the-line finishes and appliances throughout. The open-concept main floor flows from a designer kitchen into a plush living room anchored by a fireplace — perfect for slow mornings or wind-down nights after a day on Broadway.

Four bedrooms are dressed with hotel-quality linens and blackout treatments for guests keeping late Nashville hours. Each space is thoughtfully appointed so the home sleeps comfortably as a full group.

The showstopper is the private rooftop patio: downtown skyline views, lounge seating, and space to gather as a group with a drink in hand as the city lights come on. It's the kind of feature photos don't fully capture — you have to experience the golden hour up there to get it.

Bedrooms & Bed sizes:

Primary - King size with en suite shower

2nd - Full size bed 

3rd - 2- Full size in custom built in bunk beds

4th (ground level) - Full size bed with a large twin pullout trundle bed & en suite bathtub / shower combo

Amenities Highlights:

Full kitchen stocked with cookware, ideal for groups who want to cook in between nights on the town

High-speed WiFi throughout, ideal for remote workers or streaming after a night out

In-unit washer and dryer — pack light and stay a while

Dedicated workspace for anyone who needs to squeeze in a few work hours

Two Car Garage & Free on-site parking, a rare and valuable perk this close to downtown

Smart TV and cozy fireplace in the main living space

Guest access
You will have access to our entire home and garage.
